summary_rationale: Gilead Sciences operates one of global biopharma's highest-margin, most cash-generative specialty franchises, anchored by a $20.8B HIV portfolio (FY2025, +6% YoY; accelerating to +18% YoY to $6.2B in Q3 2026) that combines Biktarvy's 53% U.S. treatment share, newly extended April 2036 U.S. patent settlement runway, and Q3 2026 FDA approval of Bixlenvo with the breakthrough launch of twice-yearly PrEP injectable Yeztugo ($305M in Q3 2026; ~$1.0B run-rate). Livdelzi (+93% YoY to $203M in Q3 2026) and Trodelvy's June 2026 first-line mTNBC approvals (+42% YoY to $506M in Q3 2026) validate a genuine commercial inflection beyond HIV, supporting 81.0% Q3 2026 GAAP product gross margins and $9.46B of FY2025 free cash flow ($10.02B CFO). However, KPI health is rated PASS_WITH_WATCH rather than unconditional PASS because: (1) M&A capital allocation has been uneven, with $11.3B of 9M 2026 acquired IPR&D charges ($12.4B FY26E) and a $1.75B Q2 2026 Trodelvy NSCLC impairment shrinking book equity by 42.6% to $13.04B and lifting net debt to $19.79B ($6.44B cash vs. $26.23B debt as of Sep 30, 2026); (2) Kite cell therapy sales fell 18% YoY to $355M in Q3 2026 ahead of the December 23, 2026 anito-cel PDUFA decision; and (3) Biktarvy faces a 38% IRA Maximum Fair Price cut ($2,600/30-day supply, ~$1.5B annual revenue headwind) beginning January 1, 2028.
